title: Player leaderboard
summary: {n} players · {week} played in the last 7 days
noServers: No Minecraft or game server yet
noServersHint: Create a Minecraft server in Hostwerk (or a game server with the extension “Game servers”) – as soon as someone plays, the leaderboard shows up here.
noDataPeriod: Nothing happened in this period yet.
noDataPeriodHint: The extension remembers the totals once a day. A few days after installing there are values for the week and the month.
bedrockTitle: Plays through the Bedrock bridge (phone, console, Windows edition)
obsHint: Add it in OBS as a “Browser” source – transparent, without Hostwerk around it. Metric, period and server from above are already in it; also possible: ?theme=light, ?size=20, ?limit=5, ?title=0.
obsOff: There is an own address for OBS without sign-in. Switch on “Share the stream view without sign-in” in the settings – then anyone with the address sees the leaderboard.
